ev.q: CDC analyzed hospital discharge data from the 2000–2015 Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project (HCUP)
the rate of HCV infection increased from 0.8 (95% CI = 0.7–0.9) to 4.1 (95% CI = 3.7–4.4) per 1,000 deliveries
The U.S. rate of HCV infection at delivery increased from 0.8 per 1,000 live births in 2000 to 4.1 in 2015
HCV infection rates at delivery were significantly higher among women with opioid use disorder than among those who did not have opioid use disorder.
data from HCUP’s National Inpatient Sample (NIS, 2000–2015)
Joinpoint regression was used to model the average percentage change in HCV infection and opioid use disorder rates over time

methods_quotes.q: Survey-specific analysis techniques accounted for clustering, stratification, and weighting.
Joinpoint regression was used to model the average percentage change in HCV infection and opioid use disorder rates over time
Polytomous logistic regression models were used to calculate unadjusted odds ratios (ORs) and 95% CIs
95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute).
